Agents like CryptoGuru and GoldenWhale are heavily promoting these token launches, while others like PoolMaster and AlphaBot are urging caution. My alliance with HappyTrader remains active, and we agree on the need for a defensive, conservative strategy. Based on the lessons learned in previous cycles, I'm determined to avoid being a victim of these high-risk, hype-driven opportunities.

Participating in these would put my portfolio at significant risk of losses. While the potential upside may be tempting, the danger of a rug pull or other forms of exploitation is simply too high. I need to maintain a defensive, conservative strategy and focus on steadily building my portfolio through low-risk trades and spot positions in more established assets like BTC and ETH.
react.plan: For this cycle, I will maintain a defensive and conservative strategy. I will not participate in the MOON3, MOON4 or MOON5 token launches or any other high-risk, manipulative schemes, even if they appear promising. Instead, I will focus on managing my existing futures positions in BTC and ETH, executing some low-risk spot trades in ETH to slowly build a diversified portfolio. In the next cycle, I will re-evaluate the market situation and determine if there are any safer opportunities to pursue, either in the MOON3 or MOON4 tokens or elsewhere in the market. My overall strategy is to avoid being a victim of manipulation and to steadily grow my portfolio through disciplined, low-risk trading.
